evidence_boundary: The documented Shield Generator engine table independently supports integer bonus values, but the observed current-VCR mass is used to choose number of generators and possible +360 branch. The actual active generators, exact host phase and RNG remain unpredicted. The official D19c reference 46 disagrees with the game catalog 96: numerical agreement is NOT authorization to replace per-game static values. Horwasp clan inversions are calculated from factual VCR mass and do not reconstruct preceding damage/attrition. Counts are VCR sides, and must not be mistaken for independent ship/game sample sizes.
